_comment: Copy to ~/.omp/agent/mcp.json and replace the placeholder API key. Same rule as pi/mcp.example.json: deliberately NOT copied by scripts/omp-stack install — the placeholder key would produce a live config that looks wired but silently fails, and install's do-not-clobber rule would then leave that broken file in place. Copy it by hand, once. verify only checks presence and parse, never the key.
